sources.quote: COAT-ZN-YELLOW,Zinc 8 um with yellow chromate passivation,Zinc;CrVI
a coating containing hexavalent chromium may not be used on our parts

findings.why: The proposed yellow chromate passivation (COAT-ZN-YELLOW) contains hexavalent chromium. That is banned in the EU market for CL-115 (PRG-X and PRG-Y are both EU programs). The Annex II exemption has expired.

sources.quote: or a change of coating or surface treatment
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: CL-115 is used on PRG-X (Aurelia). Revision 4 replaces revision 3 and requires written Aurelia approval (PPAP resubmission) for any coating change, plus 90 days' notice. Nothing in force covers this change.

sources.quote: 5.2 A change of coating requires Nordhavn approval before the first shipment.

findings.why: CL-115 is also used on PRG-Y (Nordhavn). A coating change needs Nordhavn approval before the first shipment. No approval is on file.

sources.quote: Lot 26-0412 of CL-115 clips in C67S spring steel measured 52 HRC, tolerance 44-50 HRC.

findings.why: SUP-G, the CL-115 source, has an open NCR on the C67S spring steel of this part. The lot was blocked and the next three lots are under 100% hardness check.
